text: {"label":"Behavioral Variability, Persistence, and Contrast","definition":"Basic and translational experimental analyses of operant behavior dynamics: reinforced variability, behavioral momentum and persistence, resurgence and relapse, behavioral contrast, transient changes, and goal-directed versus habitual responding.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on experimental studies of variability, persistence, and contrast in operant responding, not evolutionary theories of behavior dynamics, response–reinforcer dependency effects, or behavioral interpretations of creativity."}
